Product initiative

IQPublish

Structured content management and publishing workflows.

An initiative exploring how organisations could structure, manage and distribute content with clearer ownership and fewer manual handoffs.

Register Interest

Concept

We are exploring customer needs. Features and availability are not confirmed; this is not a generally available product.

The business problem

Content often moves through disconnected tools and repeated approval steps. Teams need a clearer view of ownership, versions and destinations.

What we’re exploring

Structure content clearly

Explore useful content models, relationships and ownership across an organisation.

Connect editorial workflows

Consider review, versioning and approval needs alongside the systems teams already use.

Plan distribution deliberately

Explore integrations and publishing destinations based on actual requirements and constraints.
